# owner: platform
"""Plain-text absence notices for parents."""

from rosterkit.errors import ProjectError


def _absent_days(student, marks):
    for mark in marks:
        if mark.student_id != student.student_id:
            raise ProjectError(
                f"mark for {mark.student_id} given"
                f" with student {student.student_id}"
            )
    return sorted(
        mark.day for mark in marks if mark.status == "absent"
    )


# ---
def absence_notice(student, marks):
    """Build a short notice listing the absent days."""
    days = _absent_days(student, marks)
    if not days:
        raise ProjectError("no absences to report")
    dates = ", ".join(item.isoformat() for item in days)
    name = f"{student.first_name} {student.last_name}"
    return (
        f"{name} was absent for {len(days)} day(s): "
        f"{dates}."
    )
EOF

# owner: platform
import unittest
from datetime import date

from rosterkit.errors import ProjectError
from rosterkit.models import Mark, Student
from rosterkit.notices import absence_notice

BRAM = Student("1001", "Thistle", "Bram", "A")


class NoticeTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_lists_absent_days_in_order(self):
        marks = [
            Mark("1001", date(2026, 9, 4), "absent"),
            Mark("1001", date(2026, 9, 3), "present"),
            Mark("1001", date(2026, 9, 2), "absent")
        ]
        self.assertEqual(
            absence_notice(BRAM, marks),
            "Bram Thistle was absent for 2 day(s): "
            "2026-09-02, 2026-09-04."
        )

    def test_other_student_is_rejected(self):
        marks = [Mark("2002", date(2026, 9, 2), "absent")]
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError):
            absence_notice(BRAM, marks)

    def test_no_absences_is_rejected(self):
        marks = [Mark("1001", date(2026, 9, 2), "late")]
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError):
            absence_notice(BRAM, marks)
EOF
